correctness.rationale: Every selection is classified by doubled and single coordinate pairs; repeated orthogonal pyramiding proves the full intrinsic face polynomial and volume. Exact multinomial conditioning yields a truncated binomial pair count, which gives the joint law and exact moments. The standard binomial LLN/CLT and a uniformly bounded logarithmic correction yield joint Gaussian log fluctuations. Strict concavity establishes strict expectation-versus-typical exponent gaps. The packaged source was executed successfully with full face-lattice reconstruction in dimensions 2 to 5, rational-moment identities in dimensions 2 to 8, and volume checks. Scope: fixed 0<p<1 for asymptotics, dimension at least two, logarithmic laws conditioned on full dimension.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification for independently reducing the vertices of the canonical centrally symmetric simplicial polytope, across every dimension and including lower-dimensional outcomes. It gives exact joint laws of volume retention and the entire face vector rather than a routine one-dimensional recalculation. The strict exponential gap between expected and typical geometric complexity, plus a perfectly correlated joint fluctuation law, is relevant to judging vertex subsampling and is not implied by geometric expectations alone. Scope and independent-audit limitations are explicit.
